orderedCleanupSteps: Remove transient local artifacts first: dev logs, zip snapshots, and website/dist outputs.
Delete the unreferenced agents/ tree after confirming no external tooling points to it; keep agent/agents because the release workflow references it.
Decide whether the design/ workspace is still an active prototype. If not, archive or remove it as a single unit instead of cherry-picking files.
Review unimported website and design UI leaf components before deletion; they are not in the active route graph today but may have been scaffolded for future pages.
Preserve project-meta, generation scripts, workflow files, and runtime entry points. They are part of the current automation pipeline.
Address the existing root Vite build failure in clipExporter before using build success as a deletion gate for desktop-side files.
optionalRefactors: Consolidate shared UI primitives and styles duplicated across design/ and website/ into a shared package or shared source directory if both workspaces remain active.
Consolidate agent instructions into one canonical tree and update workflow/upload paths to remove ambiguity.
Replace zero-byte placeholder files in project-meta and generated content with explicit TODO markers or remove them if the pipeline no longer expects them.
optionalAutomation: Add a repository cleanup audit script that hashes project-owned files and reports duplicate trees in CI.
Run a dead-code pass for TS/TSX imports on website/src and src using the current route/script roots as entry points.
Add a CI check that fails if new files are added under generated artifact paths such as website/dist or ad-hoc log/zip snapshots.
